statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [PseudoEMetricSpace X] [PseudoEMetricSpace Y] (a : ℝ) (U : ℕ → Set X) (V : ℕ → Set Y), 0 ≤ a → (∀ i, (V i).Nonempty → (U i).Nonempty) → (∀ i, Metric.ediam (V i) ≤ Metric.ediam (U i)) → YuiCost a V ≤ YuiCost a U
proof:
intro X Y _ _ a U V ha hne hd
unfold YuiCost
apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
intro i
apply iSup_le
intro hv
exact le_iSup_of_le (hne i hv) (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (hd i) ha)
